title: DeVonta Smith set to return; Zack Baun, Dontayvion Wicks ruled out for Eagles

sources.title: DeVonta Smith set to return; Zack Baun, Dontayvion Wicks ruled out for Eagles
sources.description: DeVonta Smith has missed the last month with a hamstring injury, but the Eagles are set to have their top wideout back in the lineup against the Steelers on Sunday.
